## Programmatic access

```{r}
library(glue)

quarto <- yaml::read_yaml("_quarto.yml")
ds_opts <- c("dataset", "workflow")
ds <- ds_opts |> purrr::keep(\(d) !is.null(quarto$redivis[[d]]))
```

You can access data from `{{< meta redivis.`r ds` >}}` programmatically using the Redivis API for [R](https://apidocs.redivis.com/client-libraries/redivis-r){target="_blank"}, [Python](https://apidocs.redivis.com/client-libraries/redivis-python){target="_blank"}, or [JavaScript](https://apidocs.redivis.com/client-libraries/redivis-js){target="_blank"}.

::: {.panel-tabset}

## R

Install the __redivis-r__ library [from R-universe](https://redivis.r-universe.dev/){target="_blank"}:
```{.r}
install.packages("redivis", repos = c("https://redivis.r-universe.dev", "https://cloud.r-project.org"))
```

Access the data:

```{.r}
library(redivis)

user <- redivis::user("{{< meta redivis.user >}}")
`r ds` <- user$`r ds`("{{< meta redivis.`r ds` >}}")
table <- dataset$table("{{< meta redivis.table >}}")

# load table as tidyverse tibble
{{< meta redivis.table >}} <- table$to_tibble()
```

[View documentation >](https://apidocs.redivis.com/client-libraries/redivis-r){target="_blank"}

## Python

Install the __redivis-python__ library [from PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/redivis){target="_blank"}:
```{.python}
pip install --upgrade redivis
```

Access the data:
```{.python}
import redivis

user = redivis.user("{{< meta redivis.user >}}")
`r ds` = user.`r ds`("{{< meta redivis.`r ds` >}}")
table = dataset.table("{{< meta redivis.table >}}")

# load table as a pandas dataframe
{{< meta redivis.table >}} = table.to_pandas_dataframe()
```

[View documentation >](https://apidocs.redivis.com/client-libraries/redivis-python){target="_blank"}

## JS

Install the __redivis-js__ library [from NPM](https://www.npmjs.com/package/redivis){target="_blank"}:
```{.js}
npm install --save redivis
```

Access the data:

```{.js}
import * as redivis from redivis

{{< meta redivis.table >}} = await redivis
  .user('{{< meta redivis.user >}}')
  .`r ds`('{{< meta redivis.`r ds` >}}')
  .table('{{< meta redivis.table >}}')
  .listRows()
```

[View documentation >](https://apidocs.redivis.com/client-libraries/redivis-js){target="_blank"}

:::
